It features a decorative appliqué of an elephant's head and trunk on the right side, made from striped orange-and-white fabric and dark brown felt-like material for the eye and trunk details. The neck opening is reinforced with white binding. A secondary layer or pocket flap with vertical stripes is visible near the neck.
